title: Sail Sand Point
specs: US Sailing certified instructors for lessons and classes
Wide variety of sailboats and paddle craft including Optimists, Lasers, Hobie Waves, kayaks, and SUPs
Pass holder must be present and onboard the rented vessel
Passes non-transferable and only for pass holder
Participant waiver required for all sailors and paddlers
Group sizes up to 25 typically, over 35 require approval
Groups include nonprofits, schools, adaptive, corporate, private events
gap: Age minimums for rentals and lessons not stated
blurb: Guests can rent sailboats, windsurfing gear, kayaks, and paddleboards during open boating sessions or purchase season passes. Private sailing lessons are available with US Sailing certified instructors. Group programs are customizable for schools, nonprofits, corporate events, and adaptive sailing.
extraNote: Deposits for group programs are non-refundable but applied as credit · Group cancellations must be made two weeks prior for deposit refund · SSP cancels group programs for weather or poor air quality with full refund or reschedule · Cancellations must be communicated in writing or voicemail · Refunds vary based on cancellation timing; no refunds less than one week before start · Inclement weather protocols include indoor activities or rescheduling, no refunds
